name: Afghanistan
shortSummary: India built extensive development ties with Afghanistan's republic-era governments, but the 2021 Taliban takeover forced a recalibration; India maintains a technical mission in Kabul without formal recognition of the Taliban government.

name: Albania
shortSummary: India and Albania maintain modest, friendly relations with limited trade and diplomatic engagement.

name: Algeria
shortSummary: India and Algeria share Non-Aligned Movement-era solidarity, with modest hydrocarbon trade and growing defence-equipment interest.

name: Andorra
shortSummary: India-Andorra relations are minimal given the microstate's size, with largely symbolic diplomatic engagement.

name: Angola
shortSummary: India and Angola maintain a growing energy-focused relationship, with Angola among India's notable African crude oil suppliers.

name: Antigua and Barbuda
shortSummary: India and Antigua and Barbuda maintain warm Commonwealth ties, engaged through the India-CARICOM framework.

name: Argentina
shortSummary: Argentina and India share historic non-aligned solidarity and a growing critical-minerals relationship, with Indian public-sector firms investing in Argentina's lithium reserves for battery supply chains.

name: Armenia
shortSummary: India has become a significant defence supplier to Armenia in recent years, including Pinaka rocket systems and Akash air defence systems, as Armenia diversifies away from traditional Russian sourcing.

name: Australia
shortSummary: Australia and India share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, a 2022 trade agreement, and close QUAD coordination, underpinned by one of the largest Indian student and diaspora populations in the developed world.

name: Austria
shortSummary: India and Austria maintain cordial, EU-mediated ties with modest but steady trade in engineering goods and pharmaceuticals.

name: Azerbaijan
shortSummary: India-Azerbaijan relations are relatively distant, shaped by Azerbaijan's close alignment with Pakistan and Türkiye in a trilateral "brotherhood" framework that has drawn Indian wariness.

name: Bahamas
shortSummary: India and the Bahamas maintain warm Commonwealth ties with modest diplomatic and economic engagement.

name: Bahrain
shortSummary: Bahrain hosts a large Indian expatriate community and maintains warm, low-friction relations with India, with growing defence and naval engagement in the Gulf.

name: Bangladesh
shortSummary: India played a decisive role in Bangladesh's 1971 independence and built a close partnership through the Sheikh Hasina era, but relations have become more complex since the August 2024 political transition in Dhaka.

name: Barbados
shortSummary: India and Barbados maintain warm relations strengthened by shared Commonwealth ties and a modest Indo-Caribbean diaspora connection.

name: Belarus
shortSummary: India maintains a functional but modest relationship with Belarus, with some defence-industrial and pharmaceutical trade continuing despite Belarus's international isolation following the 2020 political crisis and its alignment with Russia.

name: Belgium
shortSummary: Belgium's relationship with India is anchored by the Antwerp-Surat diamond trade pipeline and its role as a diplomatic gateway to the European Union institutions headquartered in Brussels.

name: Belize
shortSummary: India and Belize maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade, engaged mainly through Commonwealth and CARICOM-adjacent forums.

name: Benin
shortSummary: India and Benin maintain modest relations, engaged through the India-Africa Forum Summit framework and development lines of credit.

name: Bhutan
shortSummary: Bhutan is one of India's closest partners, bound by a 1949 friendship treaty (revised 2007), deep hydropower cooperation, and shared strategic concern over the tri-junction with China at Doklam.

name: Bolivia
shortSummary: India and Bolivia maintain modest relations, with growing Indian interest in Bolivia's lithium reserves for battery-supply-chain needs.

name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
shortSummary: India and Bosnia and Herzegovina maintain modest, friendly relations with limited trade.

name: Botswana
shortSummary: India and Botswana maintain warm Commonwealth-linked relations, with a stable diamond-linked trade relationship.

name: Brazil
shortSummary: Brazil and India are BRICS founding partners and co-members of the IBSA Dialogue Forum, cooperating closely on Global South advocacy including joint calls for UN Security Council reform.

name: Brunei
shortSummary: India and Brunei maintain cordial, low-friction ties within the ASEAN framework, with defence training exchanges and modest hydrocarbon-linked trade.

name: Bulgaria
shortSummary: India and Bulgaria maintain steady, low-friction relations rooted in historic Cold War-era ties, with modest trade today.

name: Burkina Faso
shortSummary: India's engagement with Burkina Faso is modest and has been complicated by political instability following recent military coups.

name: Burundi
shortSummary: India and Burundi maintain modest diplomatic relations, with limited trade and development cooperation.

name: Cabo Verde
shortSummary: India and Cabo Verde maintain modest, friendly relations with limited trade.

name: Cambodia
shortSummary: India and Cambodia share cultural ties rooted in shared Hindu-Buddhist heritage, with India funding restoration work at the Angkor Wat temple complex.

name: Cameroon
shortSummary: India and Cameroon maintain modest relations, engaged through India-Africa Forum Summit development cooperation.

name: Canada
shortSummary: India-Canada relations, long anchored by one of the world's largest Indian diasporas, deteriorated sharply after September 2023, when Canada publicly alleged Indian government involvement in the killing of Sikh separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar on Canadian soil.

name: Central African Republic
shortSummary: India's engagement with the Central African Republic is minimal, constrained by the country's prolonged instability.

name: Chad
shortSummary: India's engagement with Chad is modest, constrained by regional Sahel instability.

name: Chile
shortSummary: Chile was among the first Latin American countries to sign a Preferential Trade Agreement with India, and the two cooperate increasingly on copper and lithium supply for India's clean-energy manufacturing needs.

name: China
shortSummary: India and China maintain a heavily trade-linked but strategically adversarial relationship, dominated by an unresolved and heavily militarised Himalayan border and deep mutual distrust following the 2020 Galwan clash.

name: Colombia
shortSummary: India and Colombia maintain steady, growing relations with expanding pharmaceutical and IT-sector trade.

name: Comoros
shortSummary: India and Comoros maintain friendly relations within the Indian Ocean regional security architecture, including the Colombo Security Conclave framework.

name: Costa Rica
shortSummary: India and Costa Rica maintain friendly, low-friction relations with modest trade and growing interest in renewable energy cooperation.

name: Côte d'Ivoire
shortSummary: India and Côte d'Ivoire maintain growing relations, with India a significant purchaser of Ivorian cashew nuts and cocoa.

name: Croatia
shortSummary: India and Croatia maintain cordial relations with growing tourism and shipbuilding-linked trade.

name: Cuba
shortSummary: India and Cuba share historic Non-Aligned Movement solidarity, with India providing pharmaceutical trade and humanitarian assistance including fuel and food aid during Cuba's economic difficulties.

name: Cyprus
shortSummary: India and Cyprus share historic Non-Aligned Movement solidarity, with India traditionally supportive of a unified Cyprus; ties today are modest and EU-mediated.

name: Czechia
shortSummary: India and Czechia maintain friendly relations rooted in Cold War-era Czechoslovak ties, with growing defence-industrial and automotive trade interest.

name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
shortSummary: India has contributed significant peacekeeping forces to the UN mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) over the years, alongside modest bilateral trade.

name: Denmark
shortSummary: India and Denmark elevated ties to a Green Strategic Partnership in 2020, focused on renewable energy, water management and sustainable urban development.

name: Djibouti
shortSummary: Djibouti's strategic location at the Bab-el-Mandeb strait makes it relevant to Indian naval and anti-piracy operations in the region, though bilateral ties remain modest.

name: Dominica
shortSummary: India and Dominica maintain warm Commonwealth ties, with India providing disaster-relief and development assistance following major hurricanes.

name: Dominican Republic
shortSummary: India and the Dominican Republic maintain modest, growing relations with expanding pharmaceutical and textile trade.

name: Ecuador
shortSummary: India and Ecuador maintain modest relations with growing pharmaceutical trade.

name: Egypt
shortSummary: India and Egypt, historic Non-Aligned Movement partners since the Nehru-Nasser era, elevated ties to a Strategic Partnership in 2023 when President Sisi served as India's Republic Day chief guest.

name: El Salvador
shortSummary: India and El Salvador maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Equatorial Guinea
shortSummary: India and Equatorial Guinea maintain a modest, energy-linked relationship, with some crude oil trade.

name: Eritrea
shortSummary: India and Eritrea maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Estonia
shortSummary: India and Estonia have deepened ties in recent years, particularly around digital governance, given Estonia's reputation as a digital-government pioneer.

name: Eswatini
shortSummary: India and Eswatini maintain modest Commonwealth-linked relations with limited trade.

name: Ethiopia
shortSummary: India is a significant development partner for Ethiopia, extending lines of credit for infrastructure and industrial projects, with Ethiopian Airlines and Indian pharmaceutical exports anchoring commercial ties.

name: Fiji
shortSummary: Fiji's large Indo-Fijian population (historically over a third of the country) anchors one of India's closest Pacific relationships, engaged through the FIPIC (Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation) framework.

name: Finland
shortSummary: India and Finland maintain a steady, low-friction relationship centred on clean technology and education cooperation.

name: France
shortSummary: France is one of India's most reliable defence and strategic partners, supplying Rafale fighter jets and Scorpene submarines, and co-founding the International Solar Alliance with India.

name: Gabon
shortSummary: India and Gabon maintain a modest, energy-linked relationship with some crude oil and manganese trade.

name: Gambia
shortSummary: India and the Gambia maintain modest Commonwealth-linked relations with limited trade.

name: Georgia
shortSummary: India and Georgia maintain friendly, low-friction relations, with a visa-on-arrival policy for Indians helping drive a fast-growing tourism relationship.

name: Germany
shortSummary: Germany is India's largest trading partner in the European Union, with a Strategic Partnership spanning skilled migration, green hydrogen, and substantial German industrial investment in India.

name: Ghana
shortSummary: India and Ghana maintain a substantial relationship anchored by significant Indian investment and a sizeable resident Indian business community, alongside Commonwealth ties.

name: Greece
shortSummary: India and Greece elevated ties to a Strategic Partnership in 2023, with growing defence-industrial and maritime cooperation, and shared concern over Turkish regional assertiveness.

name: Grenada
shortSummary: India and Grenada maintain warm Commonwealth ties, engaged through the India-CARICOM framework.

name: Guatemala
shortSummary: India and Guatemala maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited but growing pharmaceutical trade.

name: Guinea
shortSummary: India and Guinea maintain a modest relationship, with Indian investment in the bauxite and mining sector.

name: Guinea-Bissau
shortSummary: India and Guinea-Bissau maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Guyana
shortSummary: Guyana is home to a large Indo-Guyanese population (roughly 40% of the population), anchoring close ties, alongside growing Indian interest in Guyana's recent oil discoveries.

name: Haiti
shortSummary: India's engagement with Haiti has been limited and shaped by the country's prolonged political and security crisis, with India contributing to past UN stabilisation missions.

name: Honduras
shortSummary: India and Honduras maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Hungary
shortSummary: India and Hungary maintain steady relations, with Hungary serving as a notable hub for Indian pharmaceutical and IT investment into Central Europe.

name: Iceland
shortSummary: India and Iceland maintain modest but friendly relations with limited trade, engaged mainly through Nordic and Arctic Council-adjacent dialogues.

name: India
shortSummary: India is the world's most populous country and largest democracy, pursuing a foreign policy of strategic autonomy and multi-alignment — deepening ties with the United States, Europe, Japan and Australia through the QUAD while sustaining historic partnerships with Russia, and positioning itself as a leading voice of the Global South.

name: Indonesia
shortSummary: India and Indonesia, the world's two largest democracies in their respective regions, maintain a Strategic Partnership with growing maritime cooperation, though trade remains heavily weighted toward Indonesian coal and palm oil exports.

name: Iran
shortSummary: India's relationship with Iran centres on the strategically vital Chabahar Port, developed to bypass Pakistan for access to Afghanistan and Central Asia, though US sanctions have sharply constrained trade, including a near-total halt in oil imports since 2019.

name: Iraq
shortSummary: Iraq is consistently among India's top crude oil suppliers, though the relationship remains largely transactional and centred on energy, with limited strategic or defence dimensions.

name: Ireland
shortSummary: India and Ireland share growing economic ties, anchored by significant Irish investment in Indian IT and pharmaceutical sectors and a large Indian student population in Ireland.

name: Israel
shortSummary: India and Israel have built a close defence and technology partnership since establishing full diplomatic relations in 1992, with Israel a top-three supplier of Indian military equipment including missile defence and drone systems.

name: Italy
shortSummary: India-Italy ties were significantly strained by the 2012 "Enrica Lexie" case, in which Italian marines shot Indian fishermen; relations have since normalized following international arbitration and a renewed Strategic Partnership.

name: Jamaica
shortSummary: India and Jamaica maintain warm relations underpinned by a historic Indo-Jamaican community descended from 19th-century indentured labourers.

name: Japan
shortSummary: India and Japan share a "Special Strategic and Global Partnership," anchored by large-scale Japanese development financing, the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project, and close QUAD coordination.

name: Jordan
shortSummary: India and Jordan maintain cordial relations with growing defence cooperation and steady phosphate and fertiliser trade.

name: Kazakhstan
shortSummary: Kazakhstan anchors India's "Connect Central Asia" policy and supplies uranium for India's civil nuclear programme; India hosted the first India-Central Asia Summit in 2022.

name: Kenya
shortSummary: Kenya serves as India's key gateway to East Africa, with historic ties dating to 19th-century Indian railway labour migration and a substantial resident Indian-origin community today.

name: Kiribati
shortSummary: India engages Kiribati through the FIPIC framework, with development cooperation focused on climate resilience given the island nation's vulnerability to sea-level rise.

name: Kuwait
shortSummary: Kuwait is a significant energy supplier to India and home to roughly a million Indian expatriates; ties were elevated with a Strategic Partnership announced during PM Modi's December 2024 visit — the first Indian prime ministerial visit to Kuwait in decades.

name: Kyrgyzstan
shortSummary: India and Kyrgyzstan maintain steady ties through defence training exchanges and the India-Central Asia Summit framework.

name: Laos
shortSummary: India-Laos ties are modest but steady, engaged mainly through the Mekong-Ganga Cooperation framework and India's Act East Policy.

name: Latvia
shortSummary: India and Latvia maintain modest, friendly relations engaged mainly through EU and Baltic regional frameworks.

name: Lebanon
shortSummary: India maintains modest diplomatic ties with Lebanon and has long contributed troops to the UN peacekeeping force (UNIFIL) in southern Lebanon, amid concern over the country's political and economic instability.

name: Lesotho
shortSummary: India and Lesotho maintain modest Commonwealth-linked relations with limited trade.

name: Liberia
shortSummary: India and Liberia maintain modest relations; India has historically contributed to UN peacekeeping efforts in the country.

name: Libya
shortSummary: India's engagement with Libya has been minimal since the country descended into instability following the 2011 uprising, with limited diplomatic and commercial activity since.

name: Liechtenstein
shortSummary: India-Liechtenstein ties are minimal given the microstate's size, engaged mainly through its EFTA membership and the 2024 India-EFTA trade agreement.

name: Lithuania
shortSummary: India and Lithuania maintain modest, friendly relations with growing interest in laser-technology and biotech cooperation.

name: Luxembourg
shortSummary: Luxembourg is a notable financial hub for Indian outward investment, with modest but steady bilateral engagement.

name: Madagascar
shortSummary: India and Madagascar maintain warm relations within the Indian Ocean regional security architecture, including the Colombo Security Conclave.

name: Malawi
shortSummary: India and Malawi maintain modest Commonwealth-linked relations with development cooperation lines of credit.

name: Malaysia
shortSummary: India and Malaysia maintain substantial trade and a large diaspora-linked people-to-people relationship, though ties saw friction in 2019-20 after Malaysian leaders publicly criticised India's Kashmir and citizenship policies.

name: Maldives
shortSummary: India has long been Maldives' first responder in crises, but the relationship cooled sharply after the 2023 election of President Mohamed Muizzu on an "India Out" platform, followed by a partial reset through 2024-25.

name: Mali
shortSummary: India's engagement with Mali is modest and has been complicated by political instability following recent military coups and the broader Sahel security crisis.

name: Malta
shortSummary: India and Malta maintain warm Commonwealth-linked relations, with Malta serving as a modest hub for Indian shipping-registry and financial-services interests.

name: Marshall Islands
shortSummary: India engages the Marshall Islands through the FIPIC framework, with modest but growing development cooperation.

name: Mauritania
shortSummary: India and Mauritania maintain modest relations, with some fisheries-linked trade interest.

name: Mauritius
shortSummary: Mauritius is arguably India's closest partner in Africa, with roughly two-thirds of its population of Indian origin, deep maritime-security cooperation, and historically one of the largest sources of foreign investment into India.

name: Mexico
shortSummary: Mexico has emerged as a growing trade partner for India, particularly in pharmaceuticals and automotive components, though the relationship remains modest relative to India's other major partnerships.

name: Micronesia
shortSummary: India engages the Federated States of Micronesia through the FIPIC framework, with modest development cooperation.

name: Moldova
shortSummary: India and Moldova maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Monaco
shortSummary: India-Monaco relations are limited given the microstate's size, with engagement largely symbolic and diplomatic.

name: Mongolia
shortSummary: India describes Mongolia as a "spiritual neighbour" through shared Buddhist heritage, and has extended development financing including a line of credit for Mongolia's first oil refinery.

name: Montenegro
shortSummary: India and Montenegro maintain modest, friendly relations established after its 2006 independence.

name: Morocco
shortSummary: Morocco is a major supplier of phosphates critical to Indian fertiliser production, anchoring a growing and largely friction-free relationship.

name: Mozambique
shortSummary: India and Mozambique maintain a substantial relationship anchored by Indian investment in Mozambican natural gas projects and a historic Indian-origin trading community.

name: Myanmar
shortSummary: India engages Myanmar pragmatically for connectivity and border security despite deep concern over the country's civil conflict since the 2021 military coup, balancing the Kaladan and Trilateral Highway projects against instability along their shared border.

name: Namibia
shortSummary: India and Namibia maintain warm relations, with growing interest in uranium supply given Namibia's significant reserves.

name: Nauru
shortSummary: India engages Nauru through the FIPIC framework, with modest diplomatic ties given the country's small size.

name: Nepal
shortSummary: India and Nepal share an open border, deep cultural and religious ties, and a special relationship formalized in the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship, though the relationship periodically strains over border and sovereignty issues.

name: Netherlands
shortSummary: The Netherlands is a major hub for Indian outward investment and one of the largest sources of FDI into India, alongside growing cooperation on semiconductors and water management.

name: New Zealand
shortSummary: India and New Zealand maintain warm but modest ties, with ongoing negotiations toward a free trade agreement and a growing Indian-origin population in New Zealand.

name: Nicaragua
shortSummary: India and Nicaragua maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Niger
shortSummary: India's engagement with Niger is modest and has been complicated by the 2023 military coup and broader Sahel instability.

name: Nigeria
shortSummary: Nigeria is India's largest trading partner in Africa, driven substantially by crude oil imports and a sizeable Indian business community operating across Nigerian manufacturing and services.

name: North Korea
shortSummary: India maintains only minimal diplomatic relations with North Korea, largely constrained by United Nations sanctions and North Korea's close alignment with Pakistan and China on regional issues.

name: North Macedonia
shortSummary: India and North Macedonia maintain modest, friendly diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Norway
shortSummary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund is among the largest portfolio investors in Indian equity markets, and the two countries cooperate on ocean/maritime economy initiatives through the "Blue Economy" partnership.

name: Oman
shortSummary: Oman is one of India's oldest Gulf partners, offering the Indian Navy access to the strategically located Port of Duqm — a key node for Indian Ocean and Indo-Pacific power projection.

name: Pakistan
shortSummary: India and Pakistan share a fraught relationship rooted in the 1947 Partition, the unresolved status of Jammu & Kashmir, and repeated wars. Formal trade and high-level diplomatic engagement have been largely suspended since 2019.

name: Palau
shortSummary: India engages Palau through the FIPIC framework, with modest development cooperation.

name: Palestine
shortSummary: India has long supported Palestinian statehood, recognizing the PLO in 1974 and consistently backing a two-state solution at the UN, while also maintaining full diplomatic relations with Israel.

name: Panama
shortSummary: India and Panama maintain steady relations, with the Panama Canal relevant to Indian shipping routes and a modest Indian business presence in the Colón Free Trade Zone.

name: Papua New Guinea
shortSummary: Papua New Guinea has hosted high-level Indian engagement including a 2023 FIPIC summit co-chaired with PM Modi, reflecting India's growing Pacific outreach amid competition with China for regional influence.

name: Paraguay
shortSummary: India and Paraguay maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Peru
shortSummary: India and Peru maintain steady relations, with a Preferential Trade Agreement in force since 2016 and growing pharmaceutical exports.

name: Philippines
shortSummary: India-Philippines ties have strengthened significantly through defence trade, highlighted by the Philippines becoming the first export customer for India's BrahMos supersonic cruise missile.

name: Poland
shortSummary: India-Poland ties carry historic goodwill from World War II, when Poland's Nawanagar state sheltered Polish refugees at "Little Poland" in Balachadi, and have grown through expanding trade and 2022 evacuation cooperation.

name: Portugal
shortSummary: India and Portugal share a complex colonial history — Goa remained under Portuguese rule until 1961 — but relations today are warm, with Portugal often serving as a bridge for India-EU engagement.

name: Qatar
shortSummary: Qatar is India's largest supplier of liquefied natural gas and home to a large Indian expatriate community; the 2023-24 commutation and release of eight former Indian Navy personnel marked a notable diplomatic resolution.

name: Republic of the Congo
shortSummary: India and the Republic of the Congo maintain modest relations with limited hydrocarbon-linked trade.

name: Romania
shortSummary: India and Romania maintain warm relations rooted in Cold War-era ties, with growing IT-sector and pharmaceutical trade.

name: Russia
shortSummary: Russia remains India's "Special and Privileged Strategic Partner," rooted in decades of Soviet-era defence supply, and has grown further as India became a top buyer of discounted Russian crude oil following Western sanctions after 2022.

name: Rwanda
shortSummary: India and Rwanda maintain a growing relationship, with Indian development assistance and a small but notable Indian business presence.

name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
shortSummary: India and Saint Kitts and Nevis maintain warm Commonwealth ties, engaged through the India-CARICOM framework.

name: Saint Lucia
shortSummary: India and Saint Lucia maintain warm Commonwealth ties, engaged through the India-CARICOM framework.

name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
shortSummary: India and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines maintain warm Commonwealth ties, engaged through the India-CARICOM framework.

name: Samoa
shortSummary: India engages Samoa through the FIPIC framework, with development cooperation on climate resilience and healthcare.

name: San Marino
shortSummary: India-San Marino relations are minimal given the microstate's size, with largely symbolic diplomatic engagement.

name: São Tomé and Príncipe
shortSummary: India and São Tomé and Príncipe maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Saudi Arabia
shortSummary: Saudi Arabia is a top oil supplier and a growing strategic partner, formalized through the 2019 Strategic Partnership Council, with a large Indian expatriate workforce underpinning deep people-to-people ties.

name: Senegal
shortSummary: India and Senegal maintain a steady relationship anchored by fisheries and phosphate-linked trade and India-Africa Forum Summit cooperation.

name: Serbia
shortSummary: India and Serbia maintain historically warm relations rooted in the Non-Aligned Movement, with India supportive of Serbia's position on Kosovo's status.

name: Seychelles
shortSummary: Seychelles is one of India's closest Indian Ocean partners, with deep maritime security cooperation through the Colombo Security Conclave and Indian-funded coastal surveillance infrastructure.

name: Sierra Leone
shortSummary: India and Sierra Leone maintain modest Commonwealth-linked relations with limited trade.

name: Singapore
shortSummary: Singapore is one of India's most important economic partners — a leading source of foreign investment into India and its first comprehensive trade agreement with an ASEAN nation.

name: Slovakia
shortSummary: India and Slovakia maintain steady relations, with growing automotive and engineering-sector trade.

name: Slovenia
shortSummary: India and Slovenia maintain modest, friendly relations with limited but growing trade.

name: Solomon Islands
shortSummary: India engages the Solomon Islands through the FIPIC framework amid growing great-power competition for influence in the Pacific.

name: Somalia
shortSummary: India's engagement with Somalia has been shaped mainly by counter-piracy naval operations off its coast, given the country's prolonged instability.

name: South Africa
shortSummary: India and South Africa share a historic bond dating to Mahatma Gandhi's formative years in South Africa (1893-1914), and today cooperate closely through BRICS, IBSA, and shared Global South advocacy.

name: South Korea
shortSummary: India and South Korea maintain a Special Strategic Partnership underpinned by large Korean industrial investment — Samsung, Hyundai and LG operate major Indian manufacturing bases — and a bilateral trade agreement in force since 2010.

name: South Sudan
shortSummary: India has contributed peacekeeping forces to the UN mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) since the country's 2011 independence, amid its recurring internal conflict.

name: Spain
shortSummary: Spain's partnership with India gained significant momentum through the 2022 Tata-Airbus C295 military transport aircraft manufacturing agreement, establishing India's first private-sector military aircraft assembly line.

name: Sri Lanka
shortSummary: India and Sri Lanka maintain close ties strengthened by India's $4 billion-plus support package during Sri Lanka's 2022 economic crisis, though the relationship carries legacy sensitivities from the IPKF intervention and Tamil minority issues.

name: Sudan
shortSummary: India's relationship with Sudan has been overshadowed by the civil war that erupted in April 2023 between rival military factions; India conducted a large evacuation of its nationals (Operation Kaveri) that year.

name: Suriname
shortSummary: Suriname's large Indo-Surinamese population (roughly 27% of the population) anchors a historically warm relationship with India.

name: Sweden
shortSummary: Sweden and India cooperate closely on innovation and sustainability through the India-Sweden Innovation Partnership, alongside a long-running (though ultimately unsuccessful for India's fighter tender) defence-industrial dialogue involving Saab.

name: Switzerland
shortSummary: Switzerland led the European Free Trade Association to a landmark trade and investment pact with India in 2024, committing to substantial investment pledges over 15 years in exchange for tariff reductions.

name: Syria
shortSummary: India's engagement with Syria has been cautious and limited amid the country's prolonged civil war, deepened by the collapse of the Assad government in December 2024 and the resulting political transition.

name: Tajikistan
shortSummary: India has valued Tajikistan as a strategic partner in Central Asia, including reported logistics and medical-facility cooperation, given the country's proximity to Afghanistan.

name: Tanzania
shortSummary: India and Tanzania maintain a substantial East African relationship with a long-established Indian-origin business community and growing defence and development cooperation.

name: Thailand
shortSummary: India and Thailand share deep Buddhist and cultural ties, formalized cooperation through the Act East Policy, and are jointly developing the India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway to boost overland connectivity.

name: Timor-Leste
shortSummary: India established relations with Timor-Leste following its 2002 independence; ties remain limited but positive, with India supporting its integration into regional forums.

name: Togo
shortSummary: India and Togo maintain modest diplomatic relations with limited trade.

name: Tonga
shortSummary: India engages Tonga through the FIPIC framework, including disaster relief support after the 2022 volcanic eruption and tsunami.

name: Trinidad and Tobago
shortSummary: Trinidad and Tobago is home to one of the world's largest Indo-Caribbean communities (roughly 35-40% of the population traces Indian descent), anchoring India's closest relationship in the Caribbean.

name: Tunisia
shortSummary: India and Tunisia maintain modest, cordial ties rooted in historic Non-Aligned Movement solidarity, with limited but stable trade.

name: Türkiye
shortSummary: India-Türkiye relations are strained by Ankara's consistent vocal support for Pakistan's position on Kashmir at international forums and its defence ties to Islamabad, with tensions sharpening further in 2025.

name: Turkmenistan
shortSummary: India-Turkmenistan ties centre on long-discussed energy connectivity, notably the long-stalled TAPI (Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India) gas pipeline project.

name: Tuvalu
shortSummary: India engages Tuvalu through the FIPIC framework, with development cooperation focused on climate adaptation given the island nation's extreme vulnerability to sea-level rise.

name: Uganda
shortSummary: India and Uganda maintain a substantial relationship with a historic Indian-origin business community (notably re-established after Idi Amin's 1972 expulsion order was later reversed) and growing trade.

name: Ukraine
shortSummary: India has sought to balance humanitarian and economic engagement with Ukraine against its deep strategic ties to Russia, evacuating thousands of Indian students in 2022 and later becoming the first Indian prime minister to visit Kyiv since independence.

name: United Arab Emirates
shortSummary: The UAE is one of India's most consequential Gulf partners — a top-three trading partner, home to roughly 3.5 million Indian expatriates, and India's first Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement signed in the 2020s.

name: United Kingdom
shortSummary: India and the UK share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, culminating in a long-negotiated Free Trade Agreement signed in 2025, alongside a large Indian diaspora that anchors deep societal ties.

name: United States
shortSummary: The United States remains India's most significant strategic partner in defence, technology and the Indo-Pacific, but 2025's steep tariffs and friction over Russian oil purchases mark the most serious strain in the relationship in years, pulling the overall analytical score down from its earlier highs even as the underlying strategic partnership continues.

name: Uruguay
shortSummary: India and Uruguay maintain steady, friendly relations with modest but growing pharmaceutical and IT-sector trade.

name: Uzbekistan
shortSummary: Uzbekistan is one of India's more active Central Asian partners, with growing defence cooperation and participation in the India-Central Asia Summit framework.

name: Vanuatu
shortSummary: India engages Vanuatu through the FIPIC framework, with modest development cooperation.

name: Vatican City
shortSummary: India maintains full diplomatic relations with the Holy See, engaging periodically on interfaith dialogue and the concerns of India's Catholic community.

name: Venezuela
shortSummary: India has maintained pragmatic energy-focused ties with Venezuela, importing crude oil intermittently as US sanctions policy has shifted, while the country's political and economic crisis has limited broader engagement.

name: Vietnam
shortSummary: India and Vietnam share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership dating to Cold War-era solidarity, with substantial defence cooperation including training support and lines of credit, and joint interest in South China Sea freedom of navigation.

name: Yemen
shortSummary: India's ties with Yemen have been constrained by the country's ongoing civil war; India conducted a major evacuation of its nationals and other foreign citizens during the 2015 crisis (Operation Raahat).

name: Zambia
shortSummary: India and Zambia maintain warm Commonwealth-linked relations, with Indian investment in copper mining and pharmaceuticals.

name: Zimbabwe
shortSummary: India and Zimbabwe maintain steady relations, with Indian lines of credit supporting agricultural and infrastructure projects.
